title: Supermask plus Mirror transform inside active edges
hypothesis: With active edge count fixed at 256 of 1024 per task, a one-phase Mirror transform on a shared sparse edge basis will recover aligned task functions at test nMSE<=0.02 and reduce actual serialized bytes by >=10% versus direct two-coefficient modulation, with no additional private fallbacks; unrelated tasks will quantify where private sparse weights are needed.
physical_object: single 32x32 linear backbone with a fixed 25%-density shared support for aligned tasks
mirror_coordinate: one task phase rotates between two learned shared sparse edge-weight bases, with exactly 256 active edges
logical_multiplicity: 128 aligned task functions from one sparse support plus 16 unrelated private fallback tasks
controls: dense shared random linear backbone without task mask/view
SupSup/Piggyback-style task-specific binary mask over one dense random backbone with 256 active edges
shared sparse basis plus one free scalar gate
shared sparse two-basis modulation with two free coefficients/task and identical private fallback
shared sparse two-basis modulation with one Mirror phase/task and identical private fallback
independent FP16 full task matrices as upper control

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: fixed-timestamp ZIP of sorted NPY arrays
paid_objects: private sparse residuals or full matrices
storage.private_rule: validation nMSE > 0.02 stores the task's 256 active target edge values and indices in both direct and Mirror variants

gates.promising: All 3 fresh seeds: Mirror max aligned test nMSE<=0.02; Mirror total payload <=0.90x direct-pair payload and <=0.90x SupSup mask payload; no additional private fallbacks; active edges exactly 256/task.
gates.fail: Mirror quality gate missed in >=2 fresh seeds, or Mirror payload >= direct-pair payload in >=2 seeds, or private fallbacks remove the byte advantage in >=2 seeds.
gates.not_established: serialization/hash replay mismatch, split leakage, or active edge counts differ across compared methods

boundaries: synthetic post-fit linear function screen; no optimizer updates
teacher aligned functions intentionally occupy a shared sparse phase orbit
oracle task IDs and fixed active support
independent full control is not a trained SupSup reproduction
no natural task or learned capacity claim
